What I do

Editing — and only editing.
Done properly.

I take the editing off your plate so you can just film. I don't guess at your strategy or promise viral numbers — I make every clip look sharp, sound clean and hold attention to the end.

Short-form editing

Reels, TikToks and Shorts cut for rhythm and retention — strong first seconds, clean pacing, no dead air.

Captions & sound

Readable animated subtitles, balanced audio, music and SFX that fit the beat of the video.

Consistent style

Your whole feed looks like one hand made it — same fonts, colours and energy across every video.

How I work

Simple, fast, predictable.

A clear process is why clients stay. Here's exactly what working with me looks like.

01

You send footage

Drop your raw clips in any format. A short note on the vibe is enough.

02

I edit

Sent before 3 PM — you get it the same day. After 3 PM — next day.

03

You review

Up to 3 rounds of revisions included, no nickel-and-diming.

04

Ready to post

Final video delivered in the format your platform needs.

Send footage before 3 PM and it's back the same day — reliable turnaround is what you're really paying for.
